variants.name: 스톤 음각
variants.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Edit/reinterpret the supplied app icon into ONE new stylistic variant for Korean typing app 한녕.
Preserve: only the single Korean consonant "ㅎ" as the central identity, charcoal/ivory neutral palette, clear app-icon silhouette with rounded-square macOS tile, mature non-cute utility software. Correct ㅎ: one short horizontal cap, one longer horizontal stroke underneath, and one closed round counter below, with gaps between all three. Do not add ㄴ, 한, Latin H, A, other letters, faces, smiles, arrows, sparkles or mascots. Do not show an input-source badge; this task is ONLY an app icon.
Change the art direction meaningfully according to the style below, not merely recoloring the reference. Keep recognizable optical weight and generous readable counter.
No strong shine: soft broad diffused light, no mirror highlights, chrome reflections, glowing rims, glass glare, neon, bloom, candy finish, glossy plastic. Restrained material depth and shadows, crafted physical geometry rather than a completely flat vector.
Composition: ONE icon centered in a square canvas, mostly front-on, tile occupying about 80% of canvas; transparent margins outside tile. No title, captions, numbers, watermarks, collage or mockup. Crisp refined finish appropriate to small macOS app icons.
Style: monolithic carved black basalt / honed charcoal stone tile. The three ㅎ components are recessed into the surface as precise shallow engraved cavities, lined with warm pale mineral inlay. Visible inner sidewalls, slight shadows inside the glyph, almost no raised objects. Fine stone grain at a very restrained level, no coarse pebbles, no rough damage. Tile has softly chamfered edges and nearly flat top surface. Solid architectural feel. Clearly different from the raised porcelain glyph in the reference: this is ENGRAVED and inset.
